name: Objeka Toolkit
author: tazmolabs

sections.description:
Eleven native blocks, editable product stories and featured quotations, ten product layout directions, an accessible AJAX cart drawer using the WooCommerce Store API, opt-in order bumps, minimum-based shipping progress, server-calculated volume prices, sticky purchase controls, actual inventory notices, configured countdowns, specification guides and a repeatable demo importer. No page builder, telemetry or remote licensing service is included.

Ten free single-product starters and original generated photography are available through Tools > Objeka starter sites. Activation does not create content. Import one selected homepage/product, with its matching accessory optional. The separate Objeka theme supplies the native patterns and complete editable header/footer. Legal starter pages remain drafts.

Administration stays contextual: WordPress handles the declared WooCommerce dependency in its native plugin controls. Starter prerequisites and one-time import errors appear only on Tools > Objeka starter sites. The Toolkit adds no global dashboard notices, advertisements or activation redirects.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Activate the Objeka theme for its homepage patterns.
  3. Upload and activate Objeka Toolkit.
  4. Open Tools > Objeka starter sites to select one design and optional accessory.
  5. Configure real shipping, taxes, payments, policies and product information before selling.
sections.faq:
Does this process payments or fulfill supplier orders?

WooCommerce and your chosen providers handle payments and fulfillment. The toolkit does not integrate a supplier service or enable live payment methods.

Does the matcha demo create subscriptions?

No. It offers one-time bundles. Recurring billing needs a compatible subscription extension and gateway.

Is urgency data real?

Stock messages use managed WooCommerce inventory. Fixed deadlines must be configured. Browser-local reminders are labeled explicitly and do not guarantee stock or pricing.

What data is stored?

Normal WordPress/WooCommerce product, page, media and cart data. Personal reminders use local storage. Contact forms use a short-lived salted IP hash for rate limiting and route the submitted message to the configured administrator through wp_mail. No remote telemetry is added.

Does uninstall delete content?

No. Products, pages, media and merchant edits are retained.
sections.changelog:
1.6.1

Remove global dashboard notices. Use native WordPress dependency controls; show prerequisite guidance and one-time import errors only on the starter screen, with capability checks and retry guidance. Existing features and merchant content are unchanged.

1.6.0

WordPress.org preparation: standalone theme navigation and post archives, native pattern fallbacks, complete resource inventory, optimized screenshot, correct attribute escaping, consistent LF source and tazmolabs author metadata. Existing free features remain free; no Pro URL is shipped.

1.5.0

Single-product starter library: ten free designs, complete free customization, selected-site imports with optional accessories, no activation seeding, and retirement of the multi-product demo.

1.4.0

Nine expanded product campaigns, richer buying guides, three new detail photographs and automatic site-wide demo palettes including cart and checkout.

1.3.0

Product Offer block with live prices and native simple-product purchasing on landing pages.

1.2.0

Editable product stories and shared featured reviews, approved WooCommerce review integration, ten independent product templates, movable story sections and a bundled handbook destination.

1.1.0

Initial release.
